proposals.evidence: Liljegren and Svärd (2017, section 4) propose a tá-family connection for these particles, comparing Kalasha ta, Gawri tä, Waigali da and Kati de. Exact formation remains open among tátas, táthā, tadā́ and tā́t. The proposed link indexes that family provisionally; it does not select one formation or a borrowing direction. Postpositional ta from/of and past-tense tā are excluded.
